question: Which state hosted the 7th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bihar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bihar was the host state of the 7th Khelo India Youth Games 2025.
 
• It marked the first time Bihar hosted the event, held across multiple cities in the state.
 
• The games were co-hosted with New Delhi, bringing together youth athletes from across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karnataka**

 
 
• Hosted the 1st Khelo India Youth Games (2018).
 
• Regular contributor to India’s medal tally.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**
 
 
• Hosted the Khelo India Youth Games (2022).
 
• Known for strong sports infrastructure and medal performance.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**
 
 
• Hosted KIYG in 2019.
 
• State has a high participation base in school and college sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games**

 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a flagship initiative by the Government of India to promote sports culture and identify talent at the grassroots level.
 
• Launched in 2018, the games feature athletes under the age of 21 competing in various disciplines.
 
• The event serves as a platform to scout young talent, who are then trained under the Khelo India Talent Development program.
